description.value: Once per encounter, as a standard action, the warrior may gain a number of temporary hit points equal to twice his warrior level plus his Constitution modifier. Once the encounter ends, if the warrior had leftover temporary hit points from this talent, he heals by that amount. He also heals the full amount if he didn't use the talent for that encounter. This talent only functions for encounters with actively hostile and threatening enemies.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Advanced Warrior Talents
